browser.driving.oneLabel: Daoris's browser is driven by {{name}} — open the session
browser.driving.severalLabel: Daoris's browser is driven by {{count}} sessions
browser.driving.tip: Handed Daoris's browser and still running: its agent may act on any page there, between your keystrokes. It counts from the handing until the session ends, whether or not it has used it yet.
browser.review.oneLabel: Set-up step #{{quest}} waits for your review: {{title}}
browser.review.tip: A set-up step showed its chain's work in Daoris's browser, and its landing waits for your review. Look there: Daoris keeps its build shown in that tab until you say whether it is right.
browser.review.unserved: No longer shown: a reload there loads your own server. Show it again to serve its build.
